Name: Furry Toddler and Baby reskin
Author: Dantler24
Description: The way to install this mod is to find your Stardew Valley folder and create a backup of your baby, baby_dark, toddler, toddler_girl, toddler_dark, toddler_girl_dark.XMB files and then extract these files to that space to replace the files. Then just boot up the game and youre good to go! If you want to recolour or change the mod go right ahead! I love this game and this mod was pretty easy to make! Enjoy! <3

Downloads.Description: Its a bunch of .xmb files. replace the ones you have after making a backup.
